$comment: A lead as Meta actually returns one. field_data is a LIST of { name, values } and every value is a STRING -- a phone number comes back as text, not a number, and so does a zip code. A faker that returned a map, or that typed those as numbers, would let an author build a flow that works on the canvas and breaks on the first real lead.

field_data.name: what_are_you_interested_in
field_data.$comment: A CUSTOM question, included deliberately. The first three names are Meta's standard ones and are stable; everything after them is whatever the advertiser typed when building the form, lower-cased and underscored. An author who assumes a fixed set of names has assumed something about somebody else's form.
